verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain docs say it can generate SBOMs that provide a complete inventory of open source components. They also describe Dynamic Dependency Resolution for building that dependency inventory, so project-level SBOM generation is claimed. Missing for 10: no evidence of SPDX or CycloneDX output formats, no evidence of generating SBOMs for container images, no step-by-step SBOM export docs, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
